settings.heading: What to send us
settings.body:
We buy outright. There is no commission and we do not sell on your behalf — if you accept our offer, we buy the piece from you.

In your message, tell us the character and studio, the scale if you know it, whether you still have the original box and inner packaging, and anything that affects condition — repairs, paint rubs, loose or missing parts, yellowing. Tell us roughly where in the UK you are, too.

Photographs

Photographs decide most offers, so please send them. The form below does not take attachments. Send the form first; we reply from a monitored email address, and you attach your photographs to that reply.

The six that help most: the piece from the front, from each side, from the back, a close shot of the face or main detail, the base and nameplate, and the outer box if you still have it. Daylight, no flash. Add a close shot of any damage rather than leaving it out — it rarely costs as much as you expect, and an accurate description means the offer does not change later.
